_comment: Worked example: the reference station KJ5GBY, San Antonio, Texas. The club view's boundary is the station's 5-mile service ring, computed by the generator (CLUB_* constants in shellbeacon-page.py / make-basemap.py) - only the places are data: the communities of the ring and the places a young club uses. Points are [latitude, longitude] in the pois' lat/lon fields; side is left, below, or default right.
